shortDescription: Offshore investors bought a net 4.12 billion rand ($250.78 million) worth of South African stocks last week, Johannesburg Stock Exchange data showed on Monday.Net purchases of bonds totalled 479.35 million rand, settlement data showed.($1 = 16.4289 rand)

children: Offshore investors bought a net 4.12 billion rand ($250.78 million) worth of South African stocks last week, Johannesburg Stock Exchange data showed on Monday.
